Your event partner in Kannur

FLIX is a stage decoration company based in Kolayad, Kuthuparamba. We design and build stages for Hindu, Christian and Muslim weddings, receptions, nikah ceremonies and birthday parties.

Today we focus on stage decoration. We are growing into complete event planning, so one partner can take care of your whole event.
